newsitem.title: UK: Gulfstream Canada completes Indonesia gas tests.
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream Canada completes Indonesia gas tests.

text.p: Gulfstream Resources Canada Ltd's subsidiary Gulfstream Resources Sukatani Ltd has completed an extended production test on the Sukatani 1 well on Java, Indonesia, the company said in a statement on Thursday.

The well produced at a constrained rate of 8.9 million cubic feet a day of natural gas at 1,300 psi flowing wellhead pressure from a depth of 1,450 metres (4,757 ft). Absolute open flow is 28 million cubic feet (782,800 cu metres) a day.

The gas will not need further processing before meeting local pipeline specifications, the company said. A 3.5 km (2.2 mile) link to the West Java sales and distribution system is now being designed and negotiations to sell the gas are underway.
The field is jointly owned by P.T.Radiant (60 percent) and Gulfstream (40 percent).
